main_text.l: idque propter opus suum; ac Eosdem

l.i: temptu asserere, ac vindicare. Quùm enim

main_text.l: ciosi sint, sed & adeo minabundi, ut vel
ijs excussus puluis ad iudicium, & vindi-
cam apud Deum valeat; eorum certè

l.i: preces ad gloriam tuam temporalem in hac
vita stabiliendam, & ad coelestem in futura
utramque Pietati T. ex animo humillimè

page.notes: The first word "idque" carries a mark over the q as printed; read as idque. The line-end "Eosdem" is followed by a catch-mark; the word is taken as whole. The Google watermark at the lower right is excluded as digitiser's mark. No page number is printed. The "ELEN-" catchword is the start of the next gathering's first word.
